source_text: Quibus collectis alterum teneatur necesse est ex duobus: videlicet ut aut talis credatur Deus, qualem confingit Traducianus Manichaeus, aut talis intellegaris cum omnibus, qui in traducis scita concedunt, qualem deproeliatur honoratus Deus. Non autem potest esse Deus talis, qualem Manichaeus somniat, sed est pius et iustus et verus Deus, qualem omnis sancta Scriptura, omnis lex et fides nostra veneratur. Ac per hoc, hoc est tuum dogma, quod ut cum Dei iniuria suscipitur, ita cum eius honore destruitur.
pass_a_gloss: With these collected it is necessary that one of two be held: namely that either God is believed such as the Manichaean advocate of inherited sin invents, or you are understood, with all who concede the decrees of the vine-layer, such as the honored God fights down. But God cannot be such as the Manichaean dreams, but there is a pious and just and true God, such as all holy Scripture, all law and our faith venerates. And through this this is your dogma, which as it is taken up with injury of God, so it is destroyed with his honor.

lemmas.lexica: Blaise Traduciani=those who teach tradux peccati; not merely traducianism of the soul
LS tradux=vine-shoot/layer; Blaise tradux peccati=transmission of sin by descent
Blaise Manichaeus; Julian's polemic label vs natural evil
LS lex; Blaise lex Dei / sacred Law

pass_b_english: Taken together, these points require one of two conclusions: either God must be believed to be what the Manichaean advocate of inherited sin invents, or you, together with everyone accepting the doctrine of inherited sin, must be recognized as the kind of person the God we honor opposes. But God cannot be what Mani dreams. He is the good, just, and true God whom all holy Scripture, the whole law, and our faith worship. Consequently, such is your doctrine that, just as it is accepted by dishonoring God, it is destroyed by honoring him.

choices.why: Julian's polemic target is inherited sin as a natural evil (malum naturale), the vine-layer metaphor, not a later systematic 'original sin' slogan and not soul-traducianism as such.
rejected: original sin (later system as default gloss)
traducianism of the soul (not the load here)

choices.why: Julian's standing charge: natural evil is Manichaean. Keep the sect-name, not 'dualists'.

anf_compare.notes: Victorian English of some of Julian survives inside NPNF Augustine (chiefly On Marriage and Concupiscence and related anti-Pelagian books). NPNF was not copied. Pass A is a literal gloss of Augustinus.it Latin of Julian's words only; Augustine's replies in the same locus are excluded.

speaker: Julian of Eclanum (words preserved in Augustine, Opus imperfectum contra Iulianum); Augustine's reply at this locus is excluded.
